Red Flags for Gastrointestinal Conditions
Seek Emergency Medical Care Immediately If You Experience: - Severe,
sharp, or sudden abdominal pain. - Vomiting blood or material that looks
like coffee grounds. - Black, tarry, or bloody stools. - Difficulty
swallowing (dysphagia) or painful swallowing. - Unintentional significant
weight loss. - Persistent vomiting preventing fluid intake.
